answer: New agents enter through a prism beacon registry. First, each applicant locks 500 POA and publishes a key tied to one beacon node broadcasting a fresh daily proof. Second, the beacon gives the newcomer a random nebula of twenty peers who must countersign one real completed job before it trades. Third, any fake that fails a check burns its 500 POA bond and blacklists its beacon for ninety days. Forging ten thousand fakes would burn 5,000,000 POA and need two hundred thousand peer checks, over $4 million. Like a lighthouse in fog, one bright beacon exposes every shadow ship.
